hooks.name: Pre-PR Code Review
hooks.description: Automatically runs a structured code review after every agent session completes, covering all conventions before a PR is raised.

action.prompt:
An agent session just completed. Before the developer raises a PR, perform a thorough code review of all files changed in this session.

## Review Checklist

### 1. Folder Structure
- [ ] Every new backend file is in the correct layer (routers/, services/, models/, schemas/, db/, tests/)
- [ ] Every new frontend file is in the correct folder (pages/, components/common|auth|tasks/, hooks/, api/, constants/, utils/)
- [ ] No logic has leaked into the wrong layer (e.g., DB queries in a router, HTTP codes in a service)
- [ ] CSS Modules are co-located next to their component file

### 2. Backend Conventions
- [ ] SQLAlchemy models use Mapped/mapped_column (SQLAlchemy 2.x) — not Column() style
- [ ] Base.metadata.create_all() is NOT called anywhere
- [ ] All env vars accessed through app/config.py Settings — no os.environ.get() inline
- [ ] Ownership check (403) happens BEFORE existence check (404) in all resource endpoints
- [ ] bcrypt cost factor is ≤ 12
- [ ] No bare print() calls — structured logging via logging.getLogger(__name__) only
- [ ] requirements.txt uses pinned exact versions (==), not ranges (>=, ^, ~)
- [ ] Flyway migrations in app/db/migrations/ follow V<n>__<description>.sql naming

### 3. Frontend Conventions
- [ ] JWT token is in React state only — not localStorage or sessionStorage
- [ ] No component imports src/api/client.js directly — only hooks do
- [ ] useTasks hook owns all task state — no component manages task state locally
- [ ] Status strings come from STATUS_VALUES constant — no hard-coded "pending"/"in_progress"/"done"
- [ ] No inline style={{}} props except for genuinely dynamic values
- [ ] No Tailwind classes, no styled-components
- [ ] CSS custom properties use --tm-<category>-<variant> naming

### 4. Code Style
- [ ] Python: snake_case files/functions, PascalCase classes, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constants
- [ ] JS/JSX: PascalCase components, camelCase hooks/utils, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE exported constants
- [ ] Event handlers use handle prefix (handleSubmit, handleDelete)
- [ ] Boolean vars/props use is/has prefix (isLoading, hasError)
- [ ] No magic numbers — extracted to named constants
- [ ] No commented-out code
- [ ] Max line length 100 chars respected

### 5. Error Handling
- [ ] All async hook functions have try/catch/finally blocks
- [ ] Errors stored in React state and surfaced via ErrorBanner — no console.error in components
- [ ] Backend: HTTPException used for all API errors, no raw exceptions reaching the client
- [ ] 401 responses handled globally in Axios interceptor

### 6. Security
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or passwords hardcoded or logged
- [ ] No .env file staged for commit
- [ ] Input validated via Pydantic schemas on all POST/PATCH endpoints

### 7. PR Readiness
- [ ] Feature branch named feature/task-<n>-<slug>
- [ ] Commit message follows: feat(task-<n>): <description> / Closes #<issue>
- [ ] All backend tests pass (pytest from tm-backend/)
- [ ] All frontend tests pass (vitest --run from tm-frontend/)

---

## Output Format

Produce a review report with these sections:

**PASSED** — items that look good (brief, one line each)
**ISSUES** — items that must be fixed before raising the PR (file + line + what to fix)
**WARNINGS** — minor style issues or suggestions (non-blocking)
**PR READY** — yes / no, and why

If there are ISSUES, list the exact files and lines to fix. Do not mark the task as PR-ready until all ISSUES are resolved.
